scenario: a project management tool tracking sprint completion and task throughput
title: Sprint Velocity Drop: Find Responsible Team
prompt: The engineering department's sprint throughput dashboard shows a concerning symptom: completed story points dropped 65% between Sprint 23 (ending 2024-03-15) and Sprint 24 (ending 2024-03-29). The VP of Engineering needs to understand which team is responsible for the decline before the quarterly planning meeting. Write a diagnostic query that identifies which team(s) experienced the largest absolute drop in completed story points between these two sprints, returning the team name, points completed in each sprint, and the absolute difference. Your query should surface the root cause team(s), not just the overall metric.
answer_key:
WITH team_sprint_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_name,
    s.sprint_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(tk.story_points) FILTER (WHERE tk.status = 'completed'), 0) AS points_completed
  FROM teams t
  CROSS JOIN sprints s
  LEFT JOIN tasks tk ON t.team_id = tk.team_id AND s.sprint_id = tk.sprint_id
  WHERE s.sprint_id IN (23, 24)
  GROUP BY t.team_name, s.sprint_id
),
team_comparison AS (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(points_completed) FILTER (WHERE sprint_id = 23) AS sprint_23_points,
    SUM(points_completed) FILTER (WHERE sprint_id = 24) AS sprint_24_points
  FROM team_sprint_totals
  GROUP BY team_name
)
SELECT
  team_name,
  sprint_23_points::TEXT,
  sprint_24_points::TEXT,
  (sprint_23_points - sprint_24_points)::TEXT AS absolute_drop
FROM team_comparison
WHERE sprint_23_points - sprint_24_points > 0
ORDER BY (sprint_23_points - sprint_24_points) DESC;
user_solution:
/* notes */
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        t.task_id,
        t.team_id,
        ts.team_name,
    	s.sprint_id,
        s.sprint_name,
        s.end_date,
    	t.story_points,
    	t.status
    FROM sprints AS s
    JOIN tasks AS t
        USING(sprint_id)
    JOIN teams AS ts
        USING(team_id)
)
SELECT 
    team_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sprint_name = 'Sprint 23' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) AS sprint_23_points,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sprint_name = 'Sprint 24' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) AS sprint_24_points,
    ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN sprint_name = 'Sprint 23' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN sprint_name = 'Sprint 24' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END)) AS absolute_drop
FROM base
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC;
